They promised a 1,8% return on investments Monday-Friday for a twenty-day period payment plan, and you couldn‚Äôt withdraw your money for 20 working days from the time you deposit. For us, this company seemed legit as it had regulations from ASIC in Australia. Then everything went wrong, we could withdraw our daily profits and the company re-invested it without our consideration. Then we contacted support they said we should not worried and our money will be with us by April. After a few weeks the website went down and we had no access to it anymore.
